claims.citation: New York Herald, 15 August 1866, p. 1, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
By Steamship New York to
August 1.
The steamship New York, Captain Ernst, from South-
ampton on the 1st of August, reached the port of New
York yesterday morning.
Our files by the New York are dated to the 1st inst., [cut]
